Set the USRDS working directory

Source: R/set_USRDS_wd.R
set_USRDS_wd.Rd

Sets the USRDS working directory for the current session, or optionally saves it permanently in the user's .Renviron file as the environment variable USRDS_WD, then maps the USRDS files found there.

Usage

set_USRDS_wd(
  path,
  permanent = FALSE,
  format_preference = c("parquet", "sas7bdat", "csv"),
  on_incomplete = c("warn", "error")
)

Arguments

path

Path to the USRDS data folder

permanent

Logical; if TRUE, appends the setting to .Renviron for persistence

format_preference

Character vector of formats to use, most preferred first: any of "parquet", "sas7bdat" and "csv". Formats left out are ignored. Applies for the rest of the session.

on_incomplete

What to do when only part of a year's claim-file group is present: "warn" (the default) or "error".

Value

The normalized path, invisibly

Details

The map keeps one file per USRDS file and year. Files are recognised by name (the file names in Appendix B and the package's claim-file tables), wherever they sit under path, without regard to case. Files with other names are counted and set aside. When a file exists in more than one format, the first format in format_preference is used by every function that reads it. Two copies of a file in the same format are an error. If only part of a year's group of claim files is present (for example some, but not all, of the 2007 institutional files), the years and missing files are reported.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
set_USRDS_wd("C:/Data/USRDS")          # Session only
set_USRDS_wd("C:/Data/USRDS", TRUE)    # Persistent across sessions

# Use SAS files where both SAS and Parquet exist
set_USRDS_wd("C:/Data/USRDS", format_preference = c("sas7bdat", "parquet"))
} # }
